quest.title: Fate's Chosen Lupical
quest.description: You are yet again led to Wolvendom. Are these Wolfhook seeds solid evidence? Are Razor and his wolf pack really behind the attack? Or are the Wolfhooks indicative of something else?
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x400, Primogem x60, Mora x14150, Teachings of Resistance x5, Adventurer's Experience x7, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: Who's there?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Chill out Razor, it's only us.

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: You... are also knight?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...So you don't know each other after all?

response.speaker: Razor
response.text: No. This girl also red, but not so burny like other girl.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: This is starting to make sense. Is this the wolf boy you were talking about?

response.speaker: Razor
response.text: No time. I sent Lupical away. People coming, bad people.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: I understand. But first, I have a few questions—

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Blood? I hope the wolves didn't attack those idiots...

talks.objective: Check for strange things along the way

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Blood droplets!

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: Not human blood, wolf blood. Lupical blood...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Loopy what now? Are you gonna tell us what it means yet?

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: Lupical is family fate gave me. When wolf accepts human as its own. Or human accepts wolf. That is Lupical.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sounds like gibberish to me.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: That's strange, where does the word come from? Surely it wasn't made up by the wolves?

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: It's just the name he gave.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: ...Who's "he"?

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: Guardian of this land.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wouldn't that be Barbatos though? He is the ruler of Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: Enough. Another clue. Follow me.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Hey, wait! This is your chance to prove your innocence!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He's already gone!

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: This is him. We find his blood. Bad men did this.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How terrible...

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: I do agree that it's awful. But that doesn't change the fact that—

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: We didn't attack village! Not us!

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: A black wolf and his pack, not from here. They try to take over land. They broke the code.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>Whose code?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: Guardian of this land.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: That's now the second time you've brought that up. Tell us who that is.

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: I take Lupical further in. Follow me, maybe you see.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's this?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, if that one from earlier was two meters high...

talks.objective: Talk to Razor about how to help the injured wolf

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Where are we?

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, help me. Collect these.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aren't those wolfhook seeds?

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: Crush them. Put on wound. Bleeding stop.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: It's true. Wolfhook seeds have a liquid coating that not only functions as a mild painkiller, but also has a hemostatic effect...

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: ...I read that in a book.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why?

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: ...I have no idea.

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: Hooks help seeds move. Liquid stops pain and bleeding.

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: Animal doesn't feel hooks, they take seeds far away.

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: ...Purple teacher told me so.

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: I stay here, take care of this one. I answer red girl's questions.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Right. And if that lot does come back, I doubt they will try their luck against a member of the Knights of Favonius.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: #Your wolf friend is not clear of my suspicion just yet. But {NICKNAME}, we'll still need to fetch those seeds.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Traveler, go and find some Wolfhooks. I need to talk with Razor.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're back! Have we got enough?

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: Yes. Enough.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Razor was just telling me about the wolven code of conduct. Mind-blowing stuff.

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Hopkins the Marvelous
dialogues.text: We've looked everywhere and haven't seen any other wolves.

dialogues.speaker: Jotun
dialogues.text: Yep, that's wolves for you. The one we managed to capture must have been sick or something.

dialogues.speaker: Hopkins the Marvelous
dialogues.text: Wh—What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: Revenge.

dialogues.speaker: Jotun
dialogues.text: It's him! The one who was raised by wolves!

dialogues.speaker: Hopkins the Marvelous
dialogues.text: Huh!?

dialogues.speaker: Hopkins the Marvelous
dialogues.text: So, it was you. I should have known, wolves aren't smart enough to be behind this.

dialogues.speaker: Hopkins the Marvelous
dialogues.text: I can't believe you would help wolves plot against humans!

dialogues.speaker: Hopkins the Marvelous
dialogues.text: They throw you some scraps and you treat them like kin? Have you forgotten what you are?

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Enough!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah! You can't talk about Razor like that!

dialogues.speaker: Jotun
dialogues.text: The Knights of Favonius are gonna let this guy off!?

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: We. Did. Not. Raid. Village.

talks.objective: Go to the grave of the Wolf of the North
Challenge the Wolf of the North

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: Please! Calm!

talks.objective: Talk to Razor and the Wolf of the North

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: Please. Calm down.

dialogues.speaker: Boreas
dialogues.text: Hmph...

dialogues.speaker: Boreas
dialogues.text: It's just like he said. An outside wolf pack coming in and breaking the rules. They will reap what they have sown.

dialogues.speaker: Boreas
dialogues.text: But Razor — you must not get involved. This is for the wolves to settle between themselves.

dialogues.speaker: Boreas
dialogues.text: You fight not with claws, but with the sword. You strike not with teeth, but with lightning...

dialogues.speaker: Boreas
dialogues.text: You are human, Razor.

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: I am not like them! I don't belong.

dialogues.speaker: Boreas
dialogues.text: You are no wolf. This is a matter for the wolves, and the wolves alone.

dialogues.speaker: Boreas
dialogues.text: And you, you are Razor's Lupical amongst humans. Your nobility stands out against others of your kind.

dialogues.speaker: Boreas
dialogues.text: If you ever wish, you may train with me.

dialogues.speaker: Boreas
dialogues.text: I have nothing further to say. May we meet again, Razor, and company...

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Hey... Razor, what's that look for? Why don't you come to the city for a few days?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah! You have a friend in Mondstadt anyway right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Y'know... that red, burny friend of yours?

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: You're not safe in the wild anymore. But I know that you don't want to hurt them.

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: I'm fine. Don't worry. But I'm not city human...

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: But also not wolf...

response.speaker: Razor
response.text: #Thank you. {NICKNAME}, Paimon and... other red girl.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Hey!? We've been with you all this time, and you still don't even know my name!?

dialogues.speaker: Razor
dialogues.text: Looks like this. Can use to stop bleeding.
